meta: Read long emails fast and reply to every point with AI: missing one request in a reply is a very common mistake.

muc.title: Long email, missed point
muc.text: Missing one request when replying to a long email is a common mistake. AI can pull out what the sender really needs.

muc.title: List the requests
muc.text: Paste the email into AI and ask it to list each request, each deadline and anything unclear to ask about.

muc.title: Draft a reply point by point
muc.text: Then ask AI to draft a reply that covers every point in order, polite and short.

muc.title: Remove private details
muc.text: Before pasting, remove account numbers, phone numbers and customer details, and reread the reply before sending.

muc.title: One long email
muc.text: Pick a long email, remove personal details, ask AI to list the requests, then compare with the list you made yourself.
